question: Point out the INCORRECT response regarding infection by human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and pregnancy:

options.opa: The scheduled cesarean does not reduce the vertical transmission rate of the virus.
options.opb: The pregnant woman will be offered the possibility of performing antiretroviral treatment whatever her stage of the disease, in order to prevent the vertical transmission of the virus.
options.opc: Vertical transmission of the virus is associated with maternal viral load.
options.opd: HIV serology must be offered to every pregnant woman at the first consultation, whatever the time of pregnancy.
options.ope: Women infected with HIV have an increased risk of spontaneous abortions, intrauterine fetal death and intrauterine growth retardation.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Scheduled cesarean" -> "reduces vertical transmission rate" -> "contradicts statement" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Antiretroviral treatment" -> "offered to pregnant women" -> "regardless of disease stage" -> "prevents vertical transmission" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Maternal viral load" -> "associated with vertical transmission" -> "higher viral load increases risk" -> 95%
CHAIN: "HIV serology" -> "must be offered to every pregnant woman" -> "at first consultation" -> "regardless of pregnancy stage" -> "unclear" -> 70%
CHAIN: "Women infected with HIV" -> "increased risk of spontaneous abortions" -> "increased risk of intrauterine fetal death" -> "increased risk of intrauterine growth retardation" -> 90%
analysis: Option opa is incorrect because a scheduled cesarean delivery can reduce the vertical transmission rate of HIV, especially when the maternal viral load is high. The other options are correct statements regarding HIV infection and pregnancy.
